metadata.title: Dynamical evolution of the young stars in the Galactic center: N-body simulations of the S-stars

notes: No eligible stars: the paper models the S-star population statistically rather than as named individual stars, and reports that none were ejected as hypervelocity stars or even slow unbound stars (T:p5-b4; see also T:p1-b4 and T:p6-b25). It therefore identifies no Galactic unbound candidate and does not follow up an individually identified candidate.
